title: The Water Margin
author: Shi Nai'an
note: Also 'Outlaws of the Marsh'. No Penguin/Oxford edition exists; find the best classics-imprint English translation (e.g. Tuttle tr. J.H. Jackson, or Foreign Languages Press tr. Sidney Shapiro) and say which.

title: The Once and Future King
author: T.H. White
note: Penguin Galaxy or Penguin Classics edition if one exists; else Ace.

title: The Story of the Stone
author: Cao Xueqin
note: Penguin Classics, five volumes (tr. David Hawkes vols 1-3, John Minford vols 4-5). Return all five volumes as separate editions with 'vol. N'.

title: The Scholars
author: Wu Jingzi
note: No Penguin/Oxford edition; find the best available English translation (e.g. tr. Yang Hsien-yi & Gladys Yang, Foreign Languages Press / Columbia UP) and say which.

title: Krieg
author: Ludwig Renn
note: English title 'War' (1929). Likely out of print; find any English edition and say so.

title: Our Town
author: Thornton Wilder
note: No Penguin/Oxford edition; find the standard Harper Perennial / Samuel French edition and say so.

title: Theogony
author: Hesiod
note: One volume holds both Hesiod works: prefer Oxford World's Classics 'Theogony and Works and Days' (tr. M.L. West); Penguin's 'Hesiod and Theognis' (tr. Dorothea Wender) is the alternative. Return one edition and say it covers both works.

title: Plautus
author: Plautus
note: Author entry on the list, not a work. Use the Penguin Classics volume 'The Pot of Gold and Other Plays' (tr. E.F. Watling) as the Book; title the Book after that volume.

title: Terence
author: Terence
note: Author entry. Use Penguin Classics 'The Comedies' (tr. Betty Radice) as the Book.

title: Xenophon
author: Xenophon
note: Author entry. Use Penguin Classics 'The Persian Expedition' (tr. Rex Warner) as the Book.

title: The Rise of the Roman Empire
author: Polybius

title: The Histories
author: Tacitus
note: Penguin Classics tr. Kenneth Wellesley (rev. Rhiannon Ash) or Oxford World's Classics tr. W.H. Fyfe.

title: The Complete Odes and Epodes
author: Horace
note: Oxford World's Classics tr. David West, or Penguin Classics tr. W.G. Shepherd.

title: Petrarch in English
author: Petrarch
note: Penguin Classics anthology ed. Thomas P. Roche Jr. or ed. Hainsworth; it is a modern editor's anthology, so its own publication year is the Original year.
